input.brief: NURRIE editorial foundation stick prelaunch, sculptural kinetic typography and tactile cocoa packaging

direction.name: The sentence is the layout
direction.idea: One short sentence, set at poster scale, is the composition. The trick that makes it an idea rather than a big headline: something from the subject sits inside the sentence where a word would be. A strip of photograph fills the gap between two words; a small live fragment of the product replaces the noun; the object the sentence names is pictured at the size of a letter. Write the sentence first, find the word that can be shown instead of said, and put the showing in its place. The reader completes the sentence with their eyes.
direction.composition: The sentence is four to seven words and runs as one or two full-width lines at 9–13vw. Inline with the type, on the baseline, sits one media slot: a rounded-rectangle or square frame exactly one line-height tall and two to three ems wide, holding a photograph or a looping crop. Above and below the sentence the screen is empty except for a small navigation line and one supporting sentence set small, both on the same left margin. Later sections repeat the grammar at smaller scale: each is a short statement on the left six columns with its proof (image, figure, list) on the right, so the page reads as a series of sentences with evidence. Generous vertical space (160px or more) between sections.
direction.typography: Display weight with real presence (medium to bold), tracking -0.03 to -0.05em, leading 0.95–1.0 so two lines sit close. The inline frame aligns to cap height and baseline exactly; set it with em units so it scales with the type.
direction.colour: A calm ground with ink at full contrast. The only colour comes from the photograph inside the sentence; if the palette has an accent, use it once, on the action.
direction.imagery: One strong, simple photograph that reads at small size (a face, an object, a texture, a horizon), cropped to a wide strip inside the sentence. The same image may open to full width in the next section, so the small slot feels like a window onto something larger.
direction.richness: The collision of big type and one live image inside it. Because there is only one image on the first screen, choose it with care and give it perfect alignment to the letters.
direction.pitfalls: The sentence must be short enough for two lines on a phone, where the inline frame drops to its own line between the two halves. Do not style one word differently to fake the device. Do not use more than one slot per sentence.

hero.name: Object splits the headline
hero.blueprint: One deep, flat ground colour. The object, a low-key studio photograph whose background matches the ground, stands at dead centre, scaled to 66% of the viewport height and tilted about 8 degrees, with its base cropped by the bottom edge. The headline is split around it: line one is centred across the object's upper fifth and line two across its lower fifth, both at clamp(64px, 5.8vw, 92px), regular weight, spanning columns 2–11, so the object fills the gap where a paragraph would normally sit. The type lies above the object in the stacking order in the light ink, so every letter stays readable where it crosses. At the object's mid-height two small text blocks at 14px face each other: the supporting sentence far left on columns 1–2, and two short facts (size, price) far right on columns 11–12, right-aligned, each 32px from its edge. Wordmark top-left; three text links top-centre; the single action top-right as a small light rectangular tab, the only light solid on the screen. The lower corners stay dark and empty.
hero.mobile: The object is 54svh tall, centred, its base cropped by the bottom edge. Line one of the headline crosses its top at 11vw and line two its lower third at 11vw, both centred inside 16px margins. The side text blocks merge into one 15px sentence under the navigation. Wordmark top-left and the action tab top-right; the links collapse to one word.
hero.headline: A two-line statement of four to six words, up to about 16 characters per line at 5.8vw, with the object standing between the lines.

type.note: A narrow, sharp display serif for headlines against a small plain sans: a five-to-one jump with nothing between. Suits agencies, bakeries and restaurants, fashion and editorial brands.

palette.name: Bone, green, chocolate
palette.note: Bone ground with chocolate-brown text takes most of the page. The green is spent on one large flat block, about a third of a screen, and on the button; all other colour comes from photographs.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Headline crossing onto a photograph
sections.blueprint: A white or pale ground. A photograph taller than it is wide, 720px wide (columns 7–12), sits flush against the right viewport edge with its top at 46% of the section's first screen and runs below the fold. The heading starts on the 32px left margin across columns 1–8: two lines of light-weight serif capitals at clamp(64px, 5.6vw, 88px), leading 1.04, the first line starting 34% down the screen and the second placed so that its right half runs onto the photograph's upper-left corner. Choose a picture whose upper-left quarter is pale enough for the ink, or set the second line twice, in the ink and in the paper colour, each copy clipped to its side of the photograph's left edge. Under the heading on columns 1–5, one paragraph of up to 25 words at 22px, leading 1.4. At the bottom-left a second, smaller photograph of 360×400px enters, cropped by the screen's lower edge, and on the next screen becomes the left half of a staggered pair with the large one. Nothing else is on the screen.
sections.mobile: The heading sits at 10vw on two lines on the 20px margin. The photograph becomes 75% of the width, flush right, and starts under the heading's first line so the second line crosses its top-left corner. The paragraph follows at 17px, then the small photograph at 50% of the width on the left margin.

sections.name: One frame, three distances
sections.blueprint: A wrapper 300vh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one frame is centred: 30vw wide at 4:5, square corners, overflow hidden. Inside it the same photograph is shown at three distances as the reader scrolls: the whole subject, then scaled to 180% toward one detail, then to 320% on a second detail (transform: scale with a transform-origin per stage, 700ms ease, switched by IntersectionObserver on three invisible markers). The sentence is delivered in halves: its first two or three words sit above the frame at clamp(56px, 8vw, 130px), centred; the last words arrive below the frame at the second stage, overlapping the frame's bottom edge by 0.3em. At the third stage one caption of 28ch at 17px appears to the right of the frame, top-aligned. The two halves together are the heading and stay within two lines.
sections.mobile: The frame grows to 70vw at 4:5 and stays sticky at centre. The first half of the sentence sits above it at 13vw, the second half below it at the same size. The third-stage caption appears under the sentence at 16px, centred.

sections.name: Lines that step across
sections.blueprint: The sequence is written, not counted. Four lines of display type, one stage per line, each a complete short clause that begins with its order word: 'First you send it.' 'Then we take it apart.' 'You choose one.' 'It ships on Friday.' Set at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 76px), leading 1.0, one line each. The first line starts on column 1 and each following line starts two columns further right (grid-column-start 1, 3, 5, 7), so the block descends as a staircase and the eye follows the diagonal. Under each line, on that line's own left edge and 12px below, a sentence of up to 34ch at 17px in the soft ink. 56px between stages. The last line may take the accent colour as the single emphasis. The first line serves as the heading; there is no title above. Leave the columns to the left of the final stage empty.
sections.mobile: Lines drop to 8.4vw and may wrap onto a second line. The staircase becomes a smaller indent of 6vw per stage, so the fourth line starts 18vw in. Each sentence sits under its line at 16px on the same indent. 40px between stages.

sections.name: Question at both edges
sections.blueprint: For a closing choice between two answers: book or ask, this date or that, the tasting or the tour. A flat field exactly 100svh tall in the darkest tone. The question is a two-line heading at clamp(110px, 11vw, 168px), leading 1.0, centred, about 54% of the width: line one with its cap line 32px under the field's top edge, line two with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The band of about 560px between them is empty except for one row at its optical centre: two solid rectangular buttons, each about 200×56px with its label at 18px in medium weight, their inner edges 120px either side of the centre axis, and between them, exactly on the axis, the word 'or' at 18px in the soft ink. 16px under the row, centred, one line at 16px in the soft ink says what happens after either choice. The type above and below closes the empty band, so it reads as held breath rather than a gap.
sections.mobile: The question drops to 18vw, still two centred lines, line one 32px from the top and line two 24px above the bottom. The buttons stack at the centre at 72% of the width, 12px apart, with 'or' between them and the line of explanation under the second.

sections.name: Wide heading, indented questions
sections.blueprint: A heading of three to five words at about 5.5vw runs from the left margin on one or two lines and is the only large thing in the section. 80px beneath it the questions begin, indented to start at column 5 and running to column 12, so the left third under the heading stays empty. Each question is a row at 22–24px in the regular weight with a chevron of two 2px strokes at the far right; rows are separated by 36px of space and no rules. Opening a row lays a tile of the one-step tone behind that row and its answer (24px padding, extending 24px beyond the text on both sides) and shows the answer at 17px with a 48ch measure. Six questions. Nothing else shares the screen; the indent against the wide heading is the composition. Build with `<details>`.
sections.mobile: The heading sits at 10vw on two lines. Questions lose the indent and run full width at 19px with 28px between rows; the open row keeps its tone tile, now bleeding to both screen edges, with the answer at 16px inside it.

sections.name: Invitation over a cropped name
sections.blueprint: Close and footer in one full-viewport field of the inverse colour. Upper third, columns 1–7: a two-line invitation at about 5vw, three to five words, with one filled rectangular button beneath it. At columns 10–12, top-aligned with the invitation, three or four social or contact links stacked at 16px. The wordmark fills the bottom of the screen at 26–30vw on one line, `white-space: nowrap`, heavier and larger than the viewport can hold: it is pushed down with `transform: translateY(30%)` so the bottom edge cuts through the letters, and a long name also runs off the right edge. `overflow: hidden` on the footer does the cropping. One row of credits and legal links at 13px sits directly above the wordmark's cap line, spread left and right. The cropped name must be recognisable from its upper two-thirds alone; test that it is.
sections.mobile: Invitation at 11vw on two lines at the top with a full-width button. Links follow as one row of words at 15px. The wordmark sits at 34vw at the bottom, cropped by both the bottom and the right edge, with the legal row above it at 12px.

references.name: bleibtgleich’26
references.idea: One thin vertical rule runs down the page and a tight bold grotesk sentence wraps around it, words stepping from one side of the line to the other.
references.hero: White page, black type. Content sits in a narrow band between 26% and 68% of the width. A 1px vertical rule drops from the top edge at 37% for two-thirds of the height. Left of it: a black blob avatar at the top, a tiny role caption at its foot. Right of it: a tiny location note at the top, the name in two lines of 90px medium grotesk at the bottom. The tagline continues below at the same size, flush to the band's left edge, running past the fold. The upper half is otherwise blank. The handle is split into two pale-grey words fixed in the bottom corners; a black menu pill sits top-right.
references.type: Akzidenz Grotesk Pro medium only, -0.05em tracking, line-height about 0.9. Two sizes: 90px (6.3vw) for every statement and 11-13px for captions and table rows, a 7:1 jump. Long words are hyphenated and stepped across lines on purpose.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #e4e4e4 #f2f2f2 — Black on white with no accent. Pale grey is used for the ghosted corner wordmark and a few small square tiles; tiny coloured rings inside those tiles are the only hue.
references.imagery: Almost none: a black blob avatar, a few 85px grey tiles each with a coloured ring, and a canvas dome of small tilted project thumbnails floating between two words.
references.layout: Everything hangs off one vertical axis at 37%: lines start either at the axis or one indent to its left, giving a stepped rag. Very wide white margins. Sections are separated by a full screen of white rather than rules or colour.

sections.description: A 90px sentence is typeset word by word around the vertical rule: one word ends just left of the rule, the next starts just right of it, and the following line is centred beneath both. Above the sentence a row of five 85px pale-grey squares, each with a small coloured ring at its centre, is spaced unevenly along one baseline, with a three-line 13px description under the second.

The heading first appears as one centred line near the bottom of an empty screen, then its two halves separate to the far left and far right edges at mid-height. In the gap a WebGL dome of fifteen or so small project thumbnails, mostly black and white, tilts in perspective like tiles on a sphere. Nothing else is on the screen.

The heading is broken into an ampersand alone in the left margin and two words stepped over three lines with a hyphen break and a growing indent. Below it a four-column table at 11px: year, site name, awarding body, award. Hairline rules sit under every row, columns align to the hero's band, and year groups are separated by a blank row.

The closing sentence is stepped over four lines with shifting indents, right of centre. To its left two tiny grey captions and an email address at 11px. Under it three 36px outlined circles with social initials, centred, then the handle at about 44px centred on the bottom edge with tiny legal text in the two corners.

steal: Draw one 1px vertical rule and typeset a large sentence around it, alternating words to either side so the line becomes the text's spine.
Split the logotype into two words, ghost them at about 10% grey, and fix one in each bottom corner of the viewport.
Leave the top half of the hero blank and start the name at 50% height so the headline runs off the fold and pulls the scroll.
references.media: No picture on the first screen, which is all type plus a small black mark. Pictures arrive later as a WebGL sphere of project thumbnails flanked by two words that slide apart on scroll, square tiles placed on separate grid cells with empty cells between them, hover thumbnails behind a text index, and one small image used as a glyph in a row of numerals; no video.
references.motion: A 2.5s progress counter runs although the page loaded in 1.5s, while a vertical line draws down with the role label at its tip. Lenis and 15 ScrollTriggers with nothing pinned: display lines rise by yPercent over 0.47s in-out at a 0.075s stagger, the globe's rotation is scrubbed across its 1178px block, the flanking words are pulled apart on a scrub, and underlines wipe in by background-size over 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1).

references.name: Colonia Zacamil
references.idea: The sentence is the layout: 'FLY TO ___ ZACAMIL' runs as one full-width line, with a strip of drone video filling the gap where a word would sit.
references.hero: Warm off-white field with no navigation at all. One line of black ultra-condensed capitals about 13vw tall sits on the vertical centre and runs edge to edge with 28px side margins: 'FLY', a wide gap, 'TO', then a rounded-corner strip of aerial video exactly as tall as the letters and half the viewport wide, then 'ZACAMIL'. A tiny mono bracket label sits above the last word. About 150px lower, a small black pill button with a white dot-in-circle at its right end is centred. Two centred lines of 24px serif sit near the bottom edge. The top third is empty.
references.type: Heathergreen, an ultra-condensed regular-weight sans, in capitals at 187px; Reckless Neue serif at 24px for the caption; Roboto Mono for the button and bracket label. Three faces, each used once, with roughly an 8:1 jump and no tracking adjustments.
references.colour: #ebe6e0 #000000 #3d4633 #8d8a84 #4d8fa3 — Warm putty paper with pure black type and button. The only colour on the page is inside the video strip: tree greens, roof greys and one patch of teal.
references.imagery: Top-down drone footage of housing blocks and trees, cropped to an extreme letterbox near 5:1 with 14px rounded corners and used as a word inside the headline; on mobile it becomes a 2:1 block between two headline lines.
references.layout: Single viewport, no scroll captured. Everything hangs on the central axis: full-width headline line mid-screen, button below, caption at the foot. About 80% of the screen is bare paper. On mobile the sentence stacks into three bands: words, video, word.
steal: Replace a word in the headline with a media strip cut to the cap height, so the picture is read as part of the sentence.
Use three type voices once each (ultra-condensed display, soft serif caption, mono button) instead of one family in many sizes.
On mobile, restack the same sentence as word / image / word at full width rather than shrinking the single line.

references.name: Vero New-York
references.idea: Treat a keepsake like couture: a slow close-up film opens, then a white 3D sculpture of a dress stays pinned at centre while one sentence in mixed capitals and italics passes over it.
references.hero: Full-bleed video with no scrim: an extreme close-up of a woman's profile against a burnt-orange wall, a blurred pale sculpture occupying the right 40% of the frame in the foreground. Exactly at centre sits the four-letter wordmark in white serif capitals, about 240px wide; 25px beneath it a one-line tagline at 20px alternates italic lowercase connectives with roman capitals. Two translucent frosted rectangles with square corners float 30px from the top corners: a 130px menu button left, a 250px commission button right, both in small capitals. A tiny chevron marks the bottom centre. Nothing else; the image carries the screen.
references.type: Louize Display at 120px (8.3vw), centred: nouns in roman capitals, connective words in lowercase italic at the same size within the same line. Beausite Classic grotesk appears only for a bold 17px lead and footer links. Serif body runs 11–16px; the footer wordmark fills the width.
references.colour: #f3f0ed #181615 #b4521f #c6a788 #ffffff #97775a — Burnt orange and skin tones in the opening film, then warm off-white pages with near-black type and a plaster-white sculpture; orange returns only inside one small photograph.
references.imagery: Shallow-focus warm video up top; a real-time 3D plaster-white bust and lace dress on off-white, cropped at neck and hem and fading into the page; one small square-cornered photo of the dress on a plinth against orange.
references.layout: Everything sits on one centre axis with wide empty flanks. Two fixed corner buttons persist as soft-shadowed white tiles. Headlines take two lines each and share the screen with the pinned 3D object; body text is confined to a 240px centred column.

sections.description: Off-white screen. The sentence is delivered in halves: first two centred lines at 8.3vw in the upper third, with a small diamond glyph beside the italic word, while a white 3D bust rises from the bottom centre at about 30% of the width. Scrolling turns the sculpture to show the laced back, now filling the full height of the centre column, and the second half of the sentence lands over the skirt in the lower third.

The skirt's hem dissolves into the off-white at the top of the screen. Beneath it is a centred text stack only about 240px wide: a three-line lead in bold grotesk at 17px, four lines of serif body at 11px, and a small white rectangular button with a diffuse shadow carrying the same italic-plus-capitals label as the header button. The lower half of the viewport is left empty.

A tiny centred eyebrow in the italic-plus-capitals style, then a two-line headline at about 8vw where each line begins with a lowercase italic word and ends in capitals, the lines offset so the block reads as a stagger. Under it, centred, one small photo about 330×290px with square corners: saturated orange backdrop, white dress on a plinth. The image is deliberately much smaller than the type.

Off-white. Top-left, a five-item vertical link list in small grotesk; under it a newsletter field drawn as a single underline with an arrow; three social links right-aligned at the same level. Then the wordmark in near-black serif capitals stretches across the full width, about 45% of the viewport tall. A final row of tiny grey legal links sits beneath.

steal: Within one serif headline, set the nouns in roman capitals and the small connective words in lowercase italic at the same size.
Pin a single white 3D object on an off-white page and deliver one sentence in two halves over its front and back as it turns.
Follow a huge two-line headline with one deliberately small, saturated photograph centred beneath it instead of a full-width image.
references.media: A full-bleed 10s studio film covers the whole first screen with no scrim, the wordmark centred on it. Then a fixed render of the dress sculpture that the camera travels down while headlines rise over it, an inset window under a headline that grows to full bleed, a pinned full-bleed stepper with right-to-left wipes, a sticky picture beside parallax pictures, a grid of 4:5 thumbnails in columns at different speeds, and a 3D coin passing through a typographic wall; 0px corners and two strict photo families, brides on burnt orange and white resin on grey.
references.motion: A preloader of about 3.5-4s: a centred serif statement with a small photo window between its lines that opens by clip-path into the hero film over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1), then the wordmark fades in. Native scroll driven by script: the beige page slides up over the fixed hero, a 3840px sticky stepper advances three photographs, and headline words rise out of line masks over 1.2-1.4s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) at 0.1s steps; images clip in over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1).
